diagnosis: Client retries immediately on 429 instead of honouring Retry-After.
reply: As a premium support customer, your ticket has been placed in the priority queue. Each 429 response carries a Retry-After header in seconds. Your client should wait at least that long, adding jitter, before retrying. If 429s persist across a whole window that indicates the plan ceiling rather than a burst. See "Reading 429 responses and backing off correctly" (kb-0014) for the full details.
